comments.text: So i had a similar story about poverty shaming when i was in HS in the early 2010s, with Polo (the style) and Polo Ralph Lauren shirts, and G Shocks by Casio. So if u wore any other brand’s polo design, they’d tell u its fake. Usually this was the US POLO ASSN brands but it could apply to the generic logoless shirts u can get at places too. So uneducated…. On top of this, i wore a classic black G Shock with the red wording, nothing fancy. But when i tried wearing that, kids didnt know mine was a vintage DW-6600 module, not the revamped and newer DW-6900 module, and tried telling me my shit was fake bc the backing didnt look like theirs. No, u idiots, i was just ahead of the curve. Maybe educate urselves on vintage fashion and u would know 🙃
